title: Against shed
subtitle: 社区社会 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）
meta: 主题语境：社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）　|　核心词汇：against　|　正文 336 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 against 的含义与所引出的成分，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1971 the counsellor kept the letter ① against the winter at the bench, and everybody in the garden said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three evenings on, people still spoke of that morning: the letter had been left ② against the wall of the shed, and nobody had asked a single question. The counsellor had come to the garden two evenings earlier and spoke little of the garden he had left behind him.

The journal for June 1965 puts it plainer. It was done ③ against his better judgement, and the listener who kept the letter had told it ④ against the wishes of his family twice before the winter came; nothing in the garden was ever done against his better judgement in those days. The listener wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every evening thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the letter at the far bench, meant something else. He said the whole business had begun ⑤ against the cold, and that nobody in his family had ever done it ⑥ against the whole village; he was not a man who explained himself, and the garden had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1978 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the journal. What the line asked for was that the letter be told ⑦ against a length of plank, and that the names be written ⑧ against the back of the door. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried against a length of plank.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1981 she kept the letter ⑨ against the winter again when nobody else would, and ⑩ against the wall of the shed, she said in 1983, that was the part nobody forgot. She kept the letter in the same bench for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the garden never forgot what had been done against the wall of the shed.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. prep. 靠着（表时间：against the winter）
B. prep. 靠着（表处所：against the wall of the shed）
C. prep. 反对（表方式／状态：against his better judgement）
D. prep. 反对（引出施动者或相关的人：be told against the wishes of his family）
E. prep. 靠着（表原因：against the cold）
F. prep. 反对（表对象／目的：against the whole village）
G. prep. 靠着（表工具／材料：against a length of plank）
H. prep. 反对（表载体／处所：written against the back of the door）

items.q: against the wall of the shed
against the wishes of his family
against the back of the door
against the wall of the shed, she said

answers.why: against 意为“靠着”，此处引出时间 the winter（那年冬天），说明那件薄薄的信是在何时留下的。
against 意为“靠着”，此处引出处所 the wall of the shed（棚屋的墙），说明东西被放在何处。
against 意为“反对”，此处引出方式或状态 his better judgement（他自己更好的判断），说明这件事是怎么做成的。
against 意为“反对”，此处引出施动者或相关的人 家人的意愿：be told against the wishes of his family。
against 意为“靠着”，此处引出原因 the cold（严寒），说明整件事由何而起。
against 意为“反对”，此处引出对象或目的 the whole village（全村人）。
against 意为“靠着”，此处引出工具或材料 a length of plank（一块木板）。
against 意为“反对”，此处引出载体 the back of the door（门背面）：names written against the back of the door。
against 意为“靠着”，1981 年母亲在无人肯做时又留下了那件薄薄的信，此处仍引出时间 the winter。
against 意为“靠着”，母亲 1983 年那句话引出的仍是那一处棚屋的墙。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1971 年那年冬天前后，谈心人把那件薄薄的信留在了长椅。（against the winter）
那件薄薄的信被放在棚屋的墙，谁也没有过问。（against the wall of the shed）
整件事是他自己更好的判断做成的，心记上写得明白。（against his better judgement）
入冬之前，那件薄薄的信已经由家人的意愿说出过两回。（be told against the wishes of his family）
叔叔说，整件事是由严寒起的。（against the cold）
他说，家里从来没有人为全村人做过这件事。（against the whole village）
answers: In 1971 the counsellor kept the letter against the winter at the bench.
The letter had been left against the wall of the shed, and nobody asked a single question.
It was done against his better judgement, or so the journal says.
The letter had been told against the wishes of his family twice before the winter came.
He said the whole business had begun against the cold.
He said nobody in his family had ever done it against the whole village.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 against 的 4 种不同用法（时间、处所、方式、原因、对象等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1971 the counsellor kept the letter against the winter, and nobody forgot it.
The letter had been left against the wall of the shed for three evenings.
The work was done against his better judgement, as it always was in those days.
The letter had been told against the wishes of his family twice before the winter came.
My mother kept the letter against the winter again when nobody else would.
The whole garden never forgot what had been done against the wall of the shed.
